article.title: Inside the Australian Royal Commission turning anti-Zionism into a crime
article.author: Lana Tatour and Noam Peleg
article.content: Australia's Royal Commission into Antisemitism has spent months letting Zionist witnesses deny genocide and recast Palestine solidarity as hate, laying the groundwork to criminalize protest, speech, and scholarship on Palestine for years to come.
